scripts.assets: npm run assets:overlay && npm run assets:nav && npm run assets:font
scripts.build:native: npm run assets && cd native && cargo build --release --example map
scripts.build:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:wasm && npm run build
scripts.check:map: npm run assets && cd native && cargo fmt --check && cargo check --example map && cd ../web && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:wasm && cd web && npm run dev
